name: kotobase-projection
description: npm deps this repo's own suite needs. It is consumed as a shadow-cljs :source-path, so a consumer supplies these at build time -- but a gate running the suite ALONE has no consumer, and without a package.json it cannot install them. Measured 2026-08-18: the suite died at Cannot find module '@noble/hashes/sha2.js' before any assertion ran. Declared under dependencies, NOT devDependencies: the fleet gate installs with --omit=dev, so a dev-scoped entry is skipped and the suite dies exactly as if the entry were absent. io-multiformats and kotobase-block-codec -- the two whose sources actually require it -- both declare it under dependencies.
